decision.summary: A multi-axis downward shift initiates abruptly at index 495 across N/E/U, with sustained offset in N and incomplete recovery in E/U through index 507. No clear opposing return is observed within the allowed context [455,545]; thus the interval is classified as uncertain. No other temporary offsets are confirmed in this region.

intervals.observation: N drops abruptly ~2 MAD at index 495, sustains offset through 507; E drops ~3 MAD at 495–496, recovers partially by 507 but not to pre-event level; U drops ~2 MAD at 495–496 and shows incomplete recovery by 507. Return is unobserved within allowed context (ends at 545), and N remains offset—no opposing return on any axis observed before 545.
